ValidationRule.description: This rule will prevent users for modifying Eloqua Tasks
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND( NOT ($Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.TaskValidations__c), RecordType.Name="Eloqua Task RT", OR( IsChanged(RecordTypeId), IsChanged(Subject ), IsChanged(WhoId), IsChanged(Priority), IsChanged( NSP_Task_type__c ), IsChanged( NSP_Location__c ), IsChanged( Status ), IsChanged(WhatId), IsChanged(OwnerId), IsChanged(ActivityDate), IsChanged( NSP_Completed_Date__c ) ) ),True,False)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not eligible to update this Task.
